text:
alex: quick heads up — Julien from NovaSupply just messaged: ETA for our H200 top-off moved to 2026-04-12 earliest. they can split into 2 shipments, air + sea. @maria can you confirm we want air for priority nodes? :airplane:

julien_vendor: hi all, sorry for the churn. we have limited AOG stock in FRA. option A: 8x air (next-week) + 12x sea (2–3w). option B: send 20x sea but include 10 loaner H200s temporarily (no extra cost, loaners from depot). customs paperwork will need HS code reclass for the loaners.

maria: thanks. pricing on Option A vs B? any rush fees for the air split?

julien_vendor: Option A: +9% freight premium (air) + standard insurance. Option B: no freight premium, loaners covered but deposit hold of €5k per loaner until serial reconciliation. loaner serials will be prefixed TEMP-*, returns 30d.

tim_ops: deposit hold OK but how do we reconcile serials? we've had mismatch issues before where depot scanned wrong S/Ns and caused RMA delays. need manifest format and AWB mapping.

julien_vendor: we'll provide manifest CSV and AWB per carton. sample: ```serial,sku,qty,awbs
TEMP-0001,H200,1,AWB12345678
H200-ABC123,H200,1,AWB87654321
``` we'll also add pallet photos.

ops_oncall: can we accept partial air at AMS depot? AMS dock only accepts up to 10 crates/day without pre-notice. If air is split across days, we need forwarder to provide exact time-windows. otherwise we need crossdock at FRA and truck to AMS.

alex: operational constraints noted. also be mindful of cluster drain windows — if we get 8 by next-week we can schedule hot-swap with 2-hour maintenance per rack. tim_ops can you confirm on-call availability?

tim_ops: yep, can do night slots. prefer single-day air window though. also: can we avoid loaners if insurance handles damage claims? loaners add bookkeeping pain.

maria: what's the net cost diff if we remove loaners and add expedited customs brokerage instead? any number?

julien_vendor: expedited customs brokerage ~€1.2k per shipment; loaner deposit applies only if we use loaners. removing loaners, Option A becomes clean but +9% freight. Option B with loaners avoids freight premium and the deposit is refundable after serial match.

srebot: [automated] procurement order check: PO-2247 flagged for split shipments, please confirm final routing within 24h to avoid warehouse allocation hold.

alex: proposal — go Option B (loaners + sea) for cost predictability, but ask vendor to air-forward the 8 most-critical serials to AMS with pre-notice and AWB mapping. that reduces immediate risk and avoids full air premium. @julien_vendor can you confirm partial air + loaners plan and share final manifest by EOD? :thumbsup:

julien_vendor: yes, we can do 8 air + 12 sea + 10 loaners (loaners overlap with sea arrivals so we can rotate). will send manifest + AWBs by EOD CET.

tim_ops: once we have manifest I will create a quick reconcile script for depot to match S/N -> AWB and generate do-not-accept flags for any duplicate serials. snippet: ```#!/bin/bash
# reconcile draft
python scripts/reconcile_serials.py --manifest manifest.csv --depot-scan scans/2026-04-09.csv```

maria: cool. please also confirm insurance value on AWB (full replacement value) and who signs for customs duties in EU.

julien_vendor: insurance = full replacement, vendor covers customs duties for the air leg, customer covers duties for sea leg (standard). will add incoterms to manifest.

alex: perfect. when manifest lands I'll post final routing + maintenance windows. thx everyone. :white_check_mark:
